name: skinny_gemm_tn_x4
description: Four-way grouped skinny TN GEMM sharing one activation: Ci[M,Ni] = A[M,K] @ Bi[Ni,K]^T for i in 0..3 (nn.Linear TN weight layout, bias-free). Motivation: hybrid-LLM decode runs groups of parallel skinny projections on the same input every token — Qwen3.8-27B's Gated DeltaNet block projects hidden states through in_proj_qkv / in_proj_z / in_proj_b / in_proj_a (N = 10240 / 6144 / 48 / 48 at K = 5120) 48 times per step. At M=1..32 each member is GEMV-like and weight-bandwidth-bound. A fused group kernel should issue one launch, load A once, and co-schedule the four B operands so tail tiles fill the GPU. The bar to beat is four independent cuBLAS calls (reference).

M.description: Token/row count. Decode is M=1; MTP/small-batch decode up to 32.

b0.description: Member-0 weight in nn.Linear layout (N0, K); compute a @ b0.T without materializing the transpose.

b1.description: Member-1 weight in nn.Linear layout (N1, K).

b2.description: Member-2 weight in nn.Linear layout (N2, K).

b3.description: Member-3 weight in nn.Linear layout (N3, K).

constraints: b0.is_contiguous() and b1.is_contiguous() and b2.is_contiguous() and b3.is_contiguous()
